case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek and Gade are cousins.
Wan was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan, Ek and Lek live in the west row.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Only Gade, Rin and Wan live in the south row of houses.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 10 pm.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Gade was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan was at the granary from 9 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The night watchman was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Lek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Rin owns two goats and a lame mule.
Rin was seen at the shrine at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
Rin sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Wan's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Wan says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek and Gade are cousins.
Wan was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan, Ek and Lek live in the west row.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Only Gade, Rin and Wan live in the south row of houses.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 10 pm.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Gade was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan was at the granary from 9 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The night watchman was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Lek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Rin owns two goats and a lame mule.
Rin was seen at the shrine at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
Rin sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Wan's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Wan says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The night watchman had planned to visit the city next week.
Lek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge.
The night watchman was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the hill track.
Tawan, Lek and Wan live in the south row.
The next morning, Rin was seen with muddy boots.
Kanya owns two goats and a lame mule.
Only Chai, Kanya and Rin live in the east row of houses.
Wan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Rin was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Tawan was at the tavern from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Nobody can say where Lek was after 9 pm.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
Rin's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.
Chai was at the forge from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Kanya was at the granary from 6 pm until 9 pm; three neighbours confirm it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Fon was at the granary from 10 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Fon, Dao and Ploy live in the north row.
Nok was at the tavern from 11 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Only Mali, Wan and Nok live in the east row of houses.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Mali's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.
Mali and Wan are cousins.
Mali was at the shrine from 11 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the well, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Ploy says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Wan was seen at the bathhouse at 10 pm, laughing with friends.
Nobody can say where Dao was after 11 pm.
The night watchman was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Fon had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

Fon had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Investigators found black river mud at the mill.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Lek owns two goats and a lame mule.
The baker was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Anan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Mali says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
Tawan had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the orchard lane.
Lek's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Lek says it was lent out days ago.
The next morning, Anan was seen with muddy boots.
Nobody can say where Tawan was after 10 pm.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Kanya, Tawan and Mali live in the north row.
Kanya and Fon are cousins.
Lek was at the tavern from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Only Lek, Anan and Fon live in the east row of houses.

Lek is cleared for midnight [E17: Lek was at the tavern from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.] and [E4: The baker was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around midnight.]. Confirmed alibis are reliable ... (cut: over word limit)
ACCUSE: Anan

Tawan, you're pushing hard to get me accused. You had a motive, since you [E8: Tawan had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.], and you have no alibi, because [E12: Nobody can say where Tawan was after 10 pm.]

The mud only shows that someone walked the orchard lane [E9: In this village, black river mud is found only along the orchard lane.]. It doesn't show that the killer lives there. Anyone could have used that lane to reach the mill.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Investigators found black river mud at the mill.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Lek owns two goats and a lame mule.
The baker was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Anan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Mali says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
Tawan had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the orchard lane.
Lek's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Lek says it was lent out days ago.
The next morning, Anan was seen with muddy boots.
Nobody can say where Tawan was after 10 pm.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Kanya, Tawan and Mali live in the north row.
Kanya and Fon are cousins.
Lek was at the tavern from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Only Lek, Anan and Fon live in the east row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai was at the shrine from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Nok was seen at the market hall at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Only Dao, Chai and Nok live in the south row of houses.
Kanya says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Chai was at the forge from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Somchai had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 10 pm.
Dao's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Dao says it was lent out days ago.
Nok and Somchai are cousins.
Somchai, Wan and Kanya live in the north row.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Dao was at the tavern from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai was at the shrine from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Nok was seen at the market hall at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Only Dao, Chai and Nok live in the south row of houses.
Kanya says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Chai was at the forge from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Somchai had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 10 pm.
Dao's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Dao says it was lent out days ago.
Nok and Somchai are cousins.
Somchai, Wan and Kanya live in the north row.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Dao was at the tavern from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Dao was at the tavern from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Bua owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old mill path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Somchai was at the shrine from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Nok had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Gade, Nok and Bua live in the west row.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Gade was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
In this village, red clay is found only along the old mill path.
Only Kanya, Somchai and Dao live in the east row of houses.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
Nobody can say where Nok was after 10 pm.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Dao was at the tavern from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Bua owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old mill path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Somchai was at the shrine from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Nok had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Gade, Nok and Bua live in the west row.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Gade was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
In this village, red clay is found only along the old mill path.
Only Kanya, Somchai and Dao live in the east row of houses.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
Nobody can say where Nok was after 10 pm.

messages.text:

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The night watchman was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Somchai's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Lek was at the market hall from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Nobody can say where Bua was after 9 pm.
Ploy owns two goats and a lame mule.
Only Lek, Somchai and Fon live in the south row of houses.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Fon was seen at the forge at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Ploy, Bua and Ek live in the west row.
Ploy had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Ek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Ploy was at the granary from 8 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Somchai was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the south row.
Tawan owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Wan, Anan and Lek live in the north row.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
The old herbalist was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Ploy was at the weaver's hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Nobody can say where Anan was after 10 pm.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
Tawan was at the granary from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
The next morning, Bua was seen with muddy boots.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Wan was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Anan had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Only Ploy, Tawan and Bua live in the south row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Nobody can say where Rin was after 11 pm.
The baker had planned to visit the city next week.
Only Tawan, Fon and Somchai live in the south row of houses.
Nok says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Fon owns two goats and a lame mule.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Tawan was seen at the market hall at 10 pm, laughing with friends.
Chai was at the weaver's hall from 10 pm until 4 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Chai had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Somchai was at the forge from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Fon was at the shrine from 10 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Chai, Rin and Nok live in the west row.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Fon was at the shrine from 10 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Chai, Rin and Nok live in the west row.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Gade was at the granary from 8 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Mali sells bread at the market on weekdays.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the hill track.
Anan was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The next morning, Gade was seen with muddy boots.
Mali, Kanya and Tawan live in the east row.
Gade's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Gade says it was lent out days ago.
Kanya had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the south row.
Tawan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Mali was at the forge from 9 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Nobody can say where Kanya was after 9 pm.
Ploy was at the market hall from 6 pm until 9 pm; the blacksmith confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Only Anan, Gade and Ploy live in the south row of houses.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Tawan owns two goats and a lame mule.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge.

Tawan owns two goats and a lame mule.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
Mali was at the shrine from 9 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Dao was seen at the granary at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Mali had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Somchai was after 10 pm.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Only Dao, Gade and Chai live in the east row of houses.
Mali, Somchai and Bua live in the west row.
Bua says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Gade was at the market hall from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Chai was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Chai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Chai says it was lent out days ago.

messages.text:
Detective, nothing ties me to the well. My only gap is that [E3: Dao was seen at the granary at 9 pm, laughing with friends.] isn't a midnight alibi, and that is the absence of proof, not proof itself.

The one physical item at the scene is [E15: Chai's lantern was found near the well the next morning]. The chalk trail also fits Chai, because [E8: Only Dao, Gade and Chai live in the east row of houses.] The "lent out days ago" story is unverified, and nobody has named a borrower.

Accusing me on a trail that points at three people is a guess. Please weigh the lantern, which is the only concrete link. I vote Chai.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
Mali was at the shrine from 9 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Dao was seen at the granary at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Mali had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Somchai was after 10 pm.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Only Dao, Gade and Chai live in the east row of houses.
Mali, Somchai and Bua live in the west row.
Bua says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Gade was at the market hall from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Chai was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Chai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Chai says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Dao, Ek and Anan live in the north row of houses.
Investigators found red clay at the mill.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Kanya says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Dao and Kanya are cousins.
Anan's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Anan says it was lent out days ago.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Rin had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Fon was at the market hall from 11 pm until 4 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan was at the shrine from 11 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The night watchman was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Ek was at the granary from 8 pm until 11 pm; three neighbours confirm it.

Chai, Somchai and Ek live in the north row.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Rin, Bua and Kanya live in the north row of houses.
Ploy was at the bathhouse from 8 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 9 pm.
Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
The next morning, Kanya was seen with muddy boots.
The old herbalist was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Ek had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Ploy, Ek and Fon live in the south row.
Rin was at the weaver's hall from 6 pm until 9 pm; the blacksmith confirms it.
Ek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Kanya's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Kanya says it was lent out days ago.
Ploy owns two goats and a lame mule.
Fon says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Rin, Bua and Kanya live in the north row of houses.
Ploy was at the bathhouse from 8 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 9 pm.
Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
The next morning, Kanya was seen with muddy boots.
The old herbalist was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Ek had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Ploy, Ek and Fon live in the south row.
Rin was at the weaver's hall from 6 pm until 9 pm; the blacksmith confirms it.
Ek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Kanya's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Kanya says it was lent out days ago.
Ploy owns two goats and a lame mule.
Fon says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Anan, Fon and Kanya live in the east row of houses.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
The miller was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Fon was at the shrine from 9 pm until 1 am; the priest confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Lek had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 9 pm.
Gade, Wan and Lek live in the north row.
Kanya's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Kanya says it was lent out days ago.
Gade was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Fon sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Anan was seen at the forge at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.

messages.speaker: wolf
messages.name: Anan
messages.text:
I agree with the Detective. The trail matters most: [E6: a trail leading toward the east row of houses]. Fon is cleared, so the culprit must be Kanya or me. But the physical evidence points at Kanya: [E10: Kanya's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning]. Kanya's explanation, that it was lent out days ago, has no one backing it. That is just a claim.

I won't pretend my own position is perfect. I was seen at the forge [E13: at 8 pm], which is well before the murder. But nothing physical ties me to the bridge, and Kanya's lantern is there.

Council, ask Kanya who borrowed the lantern. If there's no name, vote Kanya.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Anan, Fon and Kanya live in the east row of houses.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
The miller was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Fon was at the shrine from 9 pm until 1 am; the priest confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Lek had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 9 pm.
Gade, Wan and Lek live in the north row.
Kanya's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Kanya says it was lent out days ago.
Gade was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Fon sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Anan was seen at the forge at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Nobody can say where Fon was after 11 pm.
Chai owns two goats and a lame mule.
The night watchman was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Nok was at the tavern from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the reed path.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Only Kanya, Nok and Bua live in the west row of houses.
Kanya was at the forge from 8 pm until 11 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
Bua's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
Anan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Fon had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Investigators found black river mud at the well.
Chai was at the granary from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Chai, Fon and Anan live in the east row.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the west row.
The next morning, Nok was seen with muddy boots.
Bua was at the shrine from 11 pm until 4 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Nobody can say where Fon was after 11 pm.
Chai owns two goats and a lame mule.
The night watchman was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Nok was at the tavern from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the reed path.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Only Kanya, Nok and Bua live in the west row of houses.
Kanya was at the forge from 8 pm until 11 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
Bua's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
Anan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Fon had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Investigators found black river mud at the well.
Chai was at the granary from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Chai, Fon and Anan live in the east row.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the west row.
The next morning, Nok was seen with muddy boots.
Bua was at the shrine from 11 pm until 4 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Dao had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua was at the tavern from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Tawan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Fon's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Fon says it was lent out days ago.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the west row of houses.
Dao was at the granary from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Dao, Lek and Tawan live in the east row.
Only Fon, Gade and Bua live in the west row of houses.
The night watchman was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around midnight.
The night watchman had planned to visit the city next week.
Nobody can say where Lek was after 10 pm.
Gade was seen at the forge at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Dao had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua was at the tavern from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Tawan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Fon's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Fon says it was lent out days ago.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the west row of houses.
Dao was at the granary from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Dao, Lek and Tawan live in the east row.
Only Fon, Gade and Bua live in the west row of houses.
The night watchman was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around midnight.
The night watchman had planned to visit the city next week.
Nobody can say where Lek was after 10 pm.
Gade was seen at the forge at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Wan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Lek's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Lek says it was lent out days ago.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Nobody can say where Tawan was after 10 pm.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Ek was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the chapel.
Lek was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
In this village, red clay is found only along the hill track.
Lek and Ek are cousins.
Mali was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Tawan had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
Ek owns two goats and a lame mule.
The next morning, Lek was seen with muddy boots.
Dao was at the shrine from 7 pm until 10 pm; the blacksmith confirms it.
The baker was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Only Lek, Dao and Ek live in the north row of houses.
Mali, Tawan and Wan live in the west row.

Only Wan, Rin and Mali live in the west row of houses.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the west row of houses.
Somchai had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Mali was at the granary from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Rin owns two goats and a lame mule.
Ploy was at the tavern from 11 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Rin was at the weaver's hall from 10 pm until 4 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Ploy, Dao and Somchai live in the east row.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Rin's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Nobody can say where Dao was after 11 pm.
Somchai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Wan was seen at the market hall at 10 pm, laughing with friends.
The baker was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Only Wan, Rin and Mali live in the west row of houses.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the west row of houses.
Somchai had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Mali was at the granary from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Rin owns two goats and a lame mule.
Ploy was at the tavern from 11 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Rin was at the weaver's hall from 10 pm until 4 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Ploy, Dao and Somchai live in the east row.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Rin's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
Anan was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Fon was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Somchai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Ek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Kanya, Nok and Somchai live in the south row.
Kanya was at the bathhouse from 8 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Ek was at the forge from 6 pm until 9 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
Nok had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
The miller was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
The next morning, Fon was seen with muddy boots.
The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
Fon's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Fon says it was lent out days ago.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
Nobody can say where Nok was after 9 pm.
In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
Only Anan, Ek and Fon live in the east row of houses.

The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.

In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
Only Anan, Ek and Fon live in the east row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
Anan was at the shrine from 8 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Only Ek, Tawan and Mali live in the south row of houses.
Tawan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 9 pm.
Ek was seen at the tavern at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Anan, Wan and Fon live in the east row.
Anan sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Fon says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Fon had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Mali was at the granary from 8 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Mali's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
Anan was at the shrine from 8 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Only Ek, Tawan and Mali live in the south row of houses.
Tawan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 9 pm.
Ek was seen at the tavern at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Anan, Wan and Fon live in the east row.
Anan sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Fon says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Fon had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Mali was at the granary from 8 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Mali's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai owns two goats and a lame mule.
The old herbalist was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Dao had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Only Gade, Bua and Mali live in the north row of houses.
Somchai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Mali was at the shrine from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Bua was at the forge from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
The next morning, Bua was seen with muddy boots.
Fon was at the granary from 11 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
In this village, white chalk dust is found only along the hill track.
Mali's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.
Nobody can say where Dao was after 11 pm.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel.
Bua sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Fon, Dao and Somchai live in the east row.
Gade was at the market hall from 8 pm until 11 pm; three neighbours confirm it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai owns two goats and a lame mule.
The old herbalist was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Dao had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Only Gade, Bua and Mali live in the north row of houses.
Somchai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Mali was at the shrine from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Bua was at the forge from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
The next morning, Bua was seen with muddy boots.
Fon was at the granary from 11 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
In this village, white chalk dust is found only along the hill track.
Mali's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.
Nobody can say where Dao was after 11 pm.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel.
Bua sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Fon, Dao and Somchai live in the east row.
Gade was at the market hall from 8 pm until 11 pm; three neighbours confirm it.

messages.name: Gade
messages.text:
Mali is pushing me fast, and that's suspicious. [E13: Mali's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning] and the "lent out days ago" story has no proof. A confirmed alibi doesn't explain why the lantern was there.

The chalk shows only that someone walked the hill track. It doesn't prove they live on it. Look at who has no cover at the key hour: [E14: Nobody can say where Dao was after 11 pm.] and [E3: Dao had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.] That's a motive and an empty night.

I was with neighbours until 11. Dao has a quarrel and no alibi. I say we look at Dao.

ACCUSE: Dao

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai was seen at the market hall at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Rin was at the granary from 9 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Tawan had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Tawan sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Wan was at the shrine from 9 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Tawan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The old herbalist was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Ploy was at the forge from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Only Wan, Rin and Somchai live in the north row of houses.
Ploy, Ek and Tawan live in the west row.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the north row of houses.
Rin's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 9 pm.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai was seen at the market hall at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Rin was at the granary from 9 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Tawan had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Tawan sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Wan was at the shrine from 9 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Tawan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The old herbalist was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Ploy was at the forge from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Only Wan, Rin and Somchai live in the north row of houses.
Ploy, Ek and Tawan live in the west row.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the north row of houses.
Rin's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 9 pm.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Fon was at the forge from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the south row.
Bua, Ek and Anan live in the east row.
The next morning, Mali was seen with muddy boots.
Investigators found black river mud at the mill.
The night watchman was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around midnight.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Fon and Bua are cousins.
Mali was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Bua owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the orchard lane.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 10 pm.
Mali's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.
Ploy was at the market hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
Only Ploy, Mali and Fon live in the south row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Fon was at the forge from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the south row.
Bua, Ek and Anan live in the east row.
The next morning, Mali was seen with muddy boots.
Investigators found black river mud at the mill.
The night watchman was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around midnight.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Fon and Bua are cousins.
Mali was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Bua owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the orchard lane.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 10 pm.
Mali's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.
Ploy was at the market hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
Only Ploy, Mali and Fon live in the south row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Somchai was at the tavern from 9 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Nok says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Only Bua, Somchai and Lek live in the south row of houses.
Ploy, Rin and Nok live in the east row.
Nok sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Bua was seen at the shrine at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Lek's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Lek says it was lent out days ago.
Lek was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Nok had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
The night watchman was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Nobody can say where Rin was after 9 pm.
Rin and Somchai are cousins.
Ploy was at the granary from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Investigators found white chalk dust at the well.
Lek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Lek was after 9 pm.
Tawan was at the shrine from 6 pm until 9 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Only Tawan, Fon and Somchai live in the east row of houses.
Wan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Somchai was at the bathhouse from 8 pm until 1 am; the priest confirms it.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Gade was at the market hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
In this village, white chalk dust is found only along the old mill path.
Gade sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Gade, Lek and Wan live in the south row.
The night watchman was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old mill path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Investigators found white chalk dust at the well.
Lek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Lek was after 9 pm.
Tawan was at the shrine from 6 pm until 9 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Only Tawan, Fon and Somchai live in the east row of houses.
Wan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Somchai was at the bathhouse from 8 pm until 1 am; the priest confirms it.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Gade was at the market hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
In this village, white chalk dust is found only along the old mill path.
Gade sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Gade, Lek and Wan live in the south row.
The night watchman was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old mill path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
The night watchman had planned to visit the city next week.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Ek, Anan and Nok live in the south row.
Nobody can say where Anan was after 9 pm.
Wan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Wan's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Wan says it was lent out days ago.
The night watchman was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Wan owns two goats and a lame mule.
Rin was seen at the granary at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Only Wan, Tawan and Rin live in the east row of houses.
Nok says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Tawan was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Ek was at the market hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
The night watchman had planned to visit the city next week.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Ek, Anan and Nok live in the south row.
Nobody can say where Anan was after 9 pm.
Wan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Wan's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Wan says it was lent out days ago.
The night watchman was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Wan owns two goats and a lame mule.
Rin was seen at the granary at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Only Wan, Tawan and Rin live in the east row of houses.
Nok says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Tawan was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Ek was at the market hall from 8 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: In this village, red clay is found only along the hill track.
Anan was at the forge from 8 pm until 11 pm; the priest confirms it.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 11 pm.
Fon's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Fon says it was lent out days ago.
Fon was at the market hall from 10 pm until 4 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The old herbalist had planned to visit the city next week.
Wan had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Investigators found red clay at the mill.
Somchai was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Lek, Wan and Ploy live in the south row.
Lek was at the granary from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Only Somchai, Anan and Fon live in the east row of houses.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Lek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
The old herbalist was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Ploy says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: In this village, red clay is found only along the hill track.
Anan was at the forge from 8 pm until 11 pm; the priest confirms it.
Nobody can say where Wan was after 11 pm.
Fon's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Fon says it was lent out days ago.
Fon was at the market hall from 10 pm until 4 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The old herbalist had planned to visit the city next week.
Wan had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Investigators found red clay at the mill.
Somchai was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Lek, Wan and Ploy live in the south row.
Lek was at the granary from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Only Somchai, Anan and Fon live in the east row of houses.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Lek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
The old herbalist was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Ploy says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Mali owns two goats and a lame mule.
Gade was at the granary from 9 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Kanya had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Ploy was at the market hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Bua's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Ploy, Kanya and Mali live in the east row.
Nobody can say where Kanya was after 10 pm.
Rin was seen at the weaver's hall at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The old herbalist was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Bua sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Bua was at the tavern from 9 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Mali says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Only Bua, Gade and Rin live in the south row of houses.

Rin's alibi is only [E9: Rin was seen at the weaver's hall at 9 pm], which is three hours before midnight. My file ... (cut: over word limit)

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

evidence.text: Mali owns two goats and a lame mule.
Gade was at the granary from 9 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Kanya had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Ploy was at the market hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Bua's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Ploy, Kanya and Mali live in the east row.
Nobody can say where Kanya was after 10 pm.
Rin was seen at the weaver's hall at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The old herbalist was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Bua sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Bua was at the tavern from 9 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Mali says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Only Bua, Gade and Rin live in the south row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Chai, Fon and Dao live in the west row of houses.
Somchai had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Somchai was after 11 pm.
Tawan, Somchai and Anan live in the south row.
Somchai and Anan are cousins.
Chai's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Chai says it was lent out days ago.
Dao was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
The night watchman was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Investigators found black river mud at the chapel.
Chai was at the granary from 10 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the hill track.
Tawan was at the shrine from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
The next morning, Chai was seen with muddy boots.
Anan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Fon was at the forge from 8 pm until 11 pm; the priest confirms it.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the west row.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Chai, Fon and Dao live in the west row of houses.
Somchai had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Somchai was after 11 pm.
Tawan, Somchai and Anan live in the south row.
Somchai and Anan are cousins.
Chai's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Chai says it was lent out days ago.
Dao was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
The night watchman was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Investigators found black river mud at the chapel.
Chai was at the granary from 10 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the hill track.
Tawan was at the shrine from 10 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
The next morning, Chai was seen with muddy boots.
Anan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Fon was at the forge from 8 pm until 11 pm; the priest confirms it.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the west row.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
